name: io.github.zy2755/browser-ref-mcp
description: Reliable browser-control MCP server for AI agents: click by ref, self-healing sessions.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSER_MCP_CDP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Connect to a browser already running with a debug port, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9222. Leave unset to launch your own Chrome/Edge.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSER_MCP_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Run without a visible browser window (default: headed, so the user can watch and take over).

environmentVariables.name: BROWSER_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Browser profile directory, keeps logins across sessions (default: ~/.browser-mcp/profile).

environmentVariables.name: BROWSER_MCP_CHANNELS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated browser channel fallback chain (default: chrome,msedge).
